tickets.title: Prepare care-cost cash-flow projection
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost cash-flow projection for Lena and Gareth Mossbutton comparing continued home care with a move to the Coral Badger Residence memory-care studio. Use current aide hours, guaranteed income, portfolio values, and Lena’s preferred cash floor.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection for 2025-06-20.

tickets.title: Address memory-care room deposit funding source
tickets.text: Address which cash source Lena and Gareth should use for the Coral Badger Residence room deposit before the hold expires.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the deposit funding source for 2025-06-09.

tickets.title: Coordinate caregiver payment and payroll guidance
tickets.text: Coordinate with Lena Mossbutton on whether Nora Maplesprocket’s respite care payments and potential direct household payments to backup caregivers create household payroll or reporting considerations.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to coordinate on that caregiver payment and payroll question for 2025-07-01.

tickets.title: Review backup care assumption for missed shifts
tickets.text: Review whether the care budget should include private backup coverage at a higher rate for missed Pocket Lantern Home Care evening shifts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review the backup care assumption for 2025-06-17.

tickets.title: Review estate authority provisions
tickets.text: Review the trust successor trustee language and health-care directive backup agents in Lena and Gareth Mossbutton’s estate documents for consistency with the household’s present caregiving roles.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review those estate authority provisions for 2025-06-27.

tickets.title: Review concentrated Moonbadger Tools stock position
tickets.text: Review the $185,000 Moonbadger Tools stock position in the joint taxable account for care-funding potential, embedded gain, and concentration considerations.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review that position for 2025-06-25.

tickets.title: Coordinate tax impact of funding care
tickets.text: Coordinate with Tobin Thimblefern on the tax effects of funding care from taxable-account sales versus IRA withdrawals, considering the prior-year capital gains and charitable gifts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to coordinate on that tax impact question for 2025-07-03.
